source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Perennial low herb or subshrub (genus key <30 cm usually)
morphology_documented.leaves: Narrow linear, strongly aromatic and gland-dotted
morphology_documented.flowers: Perfect four-parted flowers raceme or racemose cyme; yellow or purple and cream petals

source_scope_note: Historical rank and source scope retained; genus, species, variety and comparator traits not conflated.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: The 1999 flora explicitly prefers texanum spelling, conflicting with inventory texana; modern taxon authority needs reconciliation
preservation: Additive research only; original species, images, credits and galleries untouched
